security_audit.summary: Most static detections are false positives from Markdown backticks, file paths, output templates, and review prose. Two low-severity findings are confirmed because the skill requires fetching a mutable public GitHub document for UI guidance. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or malicious semantic behavior was found.

remediation.suggestion: Pin the Web Interface Guidelines URL to a reviewed commit, vendor a copy, or mark the network fetch as optional with source verification.

content.value_statement: Frontend changes can hide accessibility, contract, and workflow regressions. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Dify-specific review checks.
actual_capabilities: Reviews React, Next.js, TypeScript, and UI changes under Dify frontend paths.
Checks accessibility issues, including labels, keyboard flow, focus handling, and popup reachability.
Applies Dify UI rules for primitives, overlays, tokens, forms, and custom icons.
Evaluates generated contracts, TanStack Query usage, mutations, SSR gates, and workspace boundaries.
Reviews performance, component ownership, TypeScript quality, i18n, and frontend test coverage.
Requires findings to include file and line evidence when available.
limitations: It is scoped to Dify frontend code and excludes backend-only reviews.
It provides review findings, not automatic fixes, unless the user asks for implementation.
It depends on local Dify documentation being available for full context.
Its external guideline check depends on GitHub availability and document integrity.

use_cases.title: Review Feature Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Frontend engineers can audit pending Dify web changes before review or merge.

use_cases.title: Protect Design System Usage
use_cases.description: Design system maintainers can check primitive boundaries, overlay behavior, tokens, and Dify UI exports.

use_cases.title: Assess Test Risk
use_cases.description: QA engineers can identify missing coverage for forms, navigation, queries, and accessibility behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Review Pending Changes
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of local frontend changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my pending Dify frontend changes. Focus on user-visible regressions and list findings by severity.

prompt_templates.title: Review Specific Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review these Dify frontend files: [paths]. Check accessibility, Dify UI usage, data contracts, performance, and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Audit A Contract Migration
prompt_templates.scenario: Review generated contract and query changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to audit this generated contract migration. Check query inputs, mutation handling, cache invalidation, SSR boundaries, and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Review A Complex UI Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across component, overlay, and state boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review a complex Dify UI flow. Trace ownership, overlays, focus, workspace boundaries, failure states, performance, and tests.

output_examples.input: Pending change review for a Dify settings form.
output_examples.output: Findings are ordered by severity, with file references, reproduction notes, and concrete fix directions.

output_examples.input: Review of a new Dify UI select component.
output_examples.output: The result highlights primitive misuse, labeling gaps, invalid value handling, and missing behavior tests.

output_examples.input: Audit of a query contract migration.
output_examples.output: The result checks generated inputs, skip-token usage, cache invalidation, workspace identity, and route boundaries.

best_practices: Provide the changed files or diff so the review can stay scoped.
Include local Dify documentation when changes touch UI primitives, overlays, or tests.
Ask for severity-ranked findings with file and line references.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for backend-only code under the API directory.
Do not ask for broad style feedback without a concrete diff or file list.
Do not treat external guideline text as the only accessibility source.

faq.question: Which projects is this skill for?
faq.answer: It is built for Dify frontend code, especially web and packages/dify-ui changes.

faq.question: Can it review pasted snippets?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review snippets, but full files give better ownership and context.

faq.question: Does it make code changes?
faq.answer: No. It returns review findings unless you separately ask your agent to implement fixes.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: UI and accessibility reviews ask the agent to fetch a public Web Interface Guidelines document.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect severity-ranked findings, open questions when needed, and a short summary with test gaps.
